desc: The adept can see into the astral plane via astral perception, but cannot use astral projection.
effect: Enables the adept to use the Sorcery Skill in astral combat.
The character cannot cast spells and has no Magic Pool.

tiers: Level 1: +1 Combat Pool die, 2 PP · Level 2: +2 dice, 3 PP · Level 3: +3 dice, 4 PP
desc: An almost sixth sense about an area and any threats around the adept.
effect: Each level gives extra dice in the Combat Pool: 1, 2 or 3.
The adept can spend Combat Pool dice to assist the Reaction Test in surprise situations (SR2 p.86).

tiers: Athletic Skills & Stealth: 0.25/die · Armed Combat, Unarmed Combat, Throwing, Projectile Weapons: 0.5/die · Firearms & Gunnery: 1/die
desc: Additional dice for use with one specific general skill.
effect: Dice bought for the general skill carry over equally to any Concentrations or Specializations of it the character knows.
When defaulting on the Skill Web, lose 1 Improved Ability die per circle crossed, in addition to the +2 target modifier per circle.
Combat Skills: the adept cannot have more extra dice than the current Combat Skill Rating. A character with Firearms 4 cannot have more than 4 additional dice.

tiers: Final rating up to ½ Racial Maximum: 0.5 per +1 · up to Racial Maximum: 1 per +1 · up to 1.5 × Racial Maximum: 1.5 per +1
desc: Raises a Physical Attribute: Body, Strength or Quickness only, not a Mental Attribute.
effect: The cost depends on how the final Attribute rating compares to the character's Racial Maximum.
If the adept later raises the Attribute with Karma in the normal manner, the cost is based on the total rating, including the magical improvement.

desc: Sensory improvements such as low-light or thermographic vision, high- or low-frequency hearing, and enhanced smell or taste.
effect: Anything that can be improved by cyberware can be improved by this power, unless it involves radio or a similar technological phenomenon.
Unlike cyberware, there are no package deals: each improvement is bought separately.
Awakenings (p.116) adds: Direction Sense, Flare Compensation, High-Frequency Hearing, Improved Scent, Improved Taste, Low-Frequency Hearing and Sound Dampening.
Flare Compensation and Sound Dampening work exactly like the cybernetic flare compensation and damper.

tiers: Up to ½ Racial Maximum: 0.5 per +1 · up to Racial Maximum: 1 per +1 · up to 1.5 × Racial Maximum: 2 per +1
desc: Additional points of Reaction.
effect: The adept receives only the Reaction bonus, and no additional Initiative dice.

tiers: +1 Initiative die: 1 PP · +2 dice: 4 PP · +3 dice: 6 PP
desc: Additional Initiative dice.
effect: Gives 1, 2 or 3 extra Initiative dice, depending on the degree of the ability purchased.

tiers: Level 1 (Strength)L: 0.5 PP · Level 2 (Strength)M: 1 PP · Level 3 (Strength)S: 2 PP · Level 4 (Strength)D: 4 PP
desc: Turns the adept's Unarmed Combat attacks, normally (Strength)M Stun, into deadly Physical damage.
effect: The adept may choose to do either the normal Stun damage or the improved Physical damage, and must declare the use of Killing Hands with the attack.
Effective against creatures with Immunity or magical defenses against normal weapons; their defensive bonuses do not count against Killing Hands.
A bare-handed strike: it cannot be augmented by weaponry or magic, though other adept abilities such as Improved Ability may be used.
Nothing stops an adept from acquiring more than one of the levels, for example (Strength)L and (Strength)D.

desc: Ignore the injury and Initiative modifiers of a number of boxes of damage equal to the levels of Pain Resistance.
effect: With 3 levels the character suffers no modifiers for Light or Moderate wounds. Once damage passes that many boxes, all modifiers apply normally.
Works equally on the Physical and Stun Condition Monitors.
Even with 10 levels the character still goes unconscious, and possibly dies, at the Deadly wound level.
Add the levels to target numbers for inflicting pain on the adept (such as torture), and subtract them from target numbers to resist pain.
Does not prevent or heal damage, and cannot improve any Damage Resistance Test.

desc: Call on the inner self to briefly boost one Physical Attribute by the level purchased.
effect: Bought separately for Strength, Body or Quickness. It cannot be bought for a Mental Attribute or for Reaction.
To boost, roll Magic Rating dice against the Attribute's current value. Any success boosts the Attribute by the full level, for a number of Combat Turns equal to the successes.
When the boost ends, resist Drain with Willpower against one-half the boosted Attribute value (round down). Every 2 successes reduce the Drain Level by one. Drain is Stun damage.
Drain Level by the boosted rating: up to ½ Racial Maximum L · up to Racial Maximum M · up to 1.5 × Racial Maximum S · beyond that D.
Not compatible with cyberware or bioware enhancements or spell-based increases. Compatible with Improved Physical Attributes.

desc: Such control over the body that the adept can resist the effects of gases, drugs and poisons.
effect: Each level gives one additional die in the Damage Resistance Test against such toxins.

desc: Allows an initiate physical adept to apply their Centering Skill to a non-physical skill.
effect: Each area must be purchased individually: Build/Repair, Combat, Knowledge, Language, Magical, Social, Technical or Vehicle.
Can also apply to Special Skills, at a cost of 1 per Special Skill.
Adepts may still use magical skills only for mundane effects; they may not cast spells.

desc: Pluck slow-moving missile weapons such as arrows, thrown knives or shuriken out of the air.
effect: Roll Reaction dice, plus Combat Pool dice if desired, against a target number of 10 minus the range-determined base target number of the incoming attack.
Example: an arrow shot at long range is Target Number 2 (10 − 8); at short range, Target Number 6 (10 − 4).
The adept must generate more successes than the attacker's Attack Test. Ties go to the attacker.

desc: Magically toughens the adept's skin to resist the effects of impact damage.
effect: Cumulative with worn impact armor.
The adept may have points of Mystic Armor up to a maximum equal to their current Magic Rating.

desc: Enter a meditative state that slows the body's metabolism, lowering its need for food, water and air and its rate of bleeding.
effect: Works in a similar manner to the Hibernate spell (SR2 p.157).
Roll Willpower dice, plus any meditative Special Skill dice, against a Target Number of 4 with any injury modifiers, and use the successes as the Hibernate spell describes.

desc: A mystical sixth sense that lets the adept function more effectively in darkness or when otherwise unable to see.
effect: Reduces the visibility penalty for blind fire or full darkness to +4.
Targets attacked by the adept still gain the normal bonuses from cover.

desc: A particularly strong ability to strike back at attackers.
effect: For each level, the adept rolls an additional die for Counterattack Tests in melee combat, armed or unarmed.
These dice can be used only for counterattacks, not for damage resistance or any other type of attack.

desc: Inflict damage in unarmed melee combat that does not take effect immediately.
effect: Declare the power before a normal Attack Test. The target makes a Damage Resistance Test as normal.
If any damage gets through, it becomes a charge of astral force in the target's aura for up to 24 hours and takes effect after a period the adept sets when attacking.
A target can be under only one delay damage attack at a time.
Anyone observing the target in astral space sees the charge. It can be removed with a Dispelling Test against the Power of the attack, with Drain equal to the attack's Damage Code.

desc: Make an unarmed attack over a short distance, striking a target without physically touching it.
effect: Range in meters equals the adept's Magic Rating. Inflicts the standard damage for an unarmed attack.
Make an Unarmed Combat Test as normal, ignoring Reach modifiers.
The target resists as against a ranged attack, with Combat Pool dice and Body, and cannot counterattack.
If the adept has either Killing Hands or Distance Strike and buys the other, the second power costs double.

desc: A limited form of astral awareness that lets the adept sense the feelings of those within unaided line of sight.
effect: A Perception (4) Test gives a general impression of a subject's current emotions. More successes give more detail.
Metamagical masking can defeat this power. An initiate adept resolves an attempt to penetrate the masking normally.

desc: The adept may use both hands equally well.
effect: Each level counts as 1 level in the Ambidexterity Special Skill (Fields of Fire p.81).
The adept must have at least 1 level of Ambidexterity to buy this power, and may not have more levels of it than levels of Ambidexterity.

desc: Unusually limber limbs, able to twist and bend more than a normal person's.
effect: Each level adds 1 die to tests to slip out of ropes, handcuffs and other bindings, and to escape from a hold in unarmed combat.
The adept can make Flexibility Tests to squeeze through small openings such as transoms and ventilation ducts; the gamemaster sets the target number.
Subtract 1 from the target number of Escape Artist Tests.

desc: Fall a distance without suffering injury.
effect: Each level lets the adept fall 2 meters without injury or a Damage Resistance Test, provided the landing surface is not itself dangerous.
For a longer fall, subtract the cushioned distance from the distance fallen before calculating damage.
On a dangerous surface the adept still avoids falling damage, but takes damage from the surface at the gamemaster's discretion.

desc: A will exceptionally resistant to outside influence.
effect: Each level adds 1 die when resisting any attempt to control, affect or alter the adept's mind.
Does not defend against mana-based combat spells.

desc: A strong, unconscious resistance to sorcery.
effect: Each level adds 1 die to Resistance Tests made against spells. Only the adept may use these dice.
Does not interfere with spells accepted voluntarily, and does not defend against critter powers.
A physical magician with this power loses 1 Magic Pool die per level when casting spells.
Initiate adepts with this power do not gain the benefits of shielding.

desc: A limited astral awareness that senses magical energies and effects within a radius of Magic Rating × 5 meters.
effect: The adept is astrally active while using the power and so is vulnerable to astral attack. Without Astral Perception the adept cannot defend against it.
Cannot be activated and deactivated in the same Combat Phase.

desc: In the adept's hands, normally harmless items such as pens, credsticks and ID cards become deadly thrown weapons.
effect: Such items are thrown with the Throwing Skill and have a base Damage Code of (one-half Strength, round down)L. Impact armor resists.
Items with an edge or point do Physical damage; blunt objects do Stun.
Standard missile weapons such as shuriken and throwing knives gain +2 Power.

desc: A strike that affects the target's nervous system instead of inflicting damage.
effect: Make a standard unarmed attack with Unarmed Combat against a base Target Number of 4, modified by the target's armor.
For every 2 net successes, reduce the target's Quickness by 1. At Quickness 0 the target is paralyzed. Lost Quickness returns at 1 point per minute.
Against critters the base Target Number is 6 or higher.
Targets without a functional nervous system, such as machines, spirits and zombies, are immune.

desc: Draw and use a single melee weapon or firearm in one action.
effect: Drawing the weapon and the attack occur in the action used for the Attack Test.
If the weapon needs only a Simple Action to use, the adept can draw it and make 2 Attack Tests in a single Combat Phase.
Must be bought twice to cover both firearms and melee weapons.
The book warns that this power may unbalance the game; the gamemaster may disallow it or raise its cost.

desc: A supernatural ability to leap into action with startling suddenness.
effect: Each level adds 1 die to Reaction Tests for Surprise made against an opponent.
The dice do not apply to tests to avoid being surprised, or to any other Reaction Test or Initiative roll.

desc: The adept recovers more quickly than normal from all forms of injury.
effect: Each level adds 1 die to Body for Healing Tests, and for Body Tests to see whether a Deadly wound causes a crippling injury.
Does not increase resistance to injury, toxins or pathogens, but speeds recovery from their effects.
Cannot counteract magic loss due to Deadly wounds, the effects of goblinization, or incurable diseases.

desc: The adept roots to the ground and becomes an immovable object.
effect: Each level adds 1 die to all tests to resist being knocked down, thrown, levitated or otherwise moved against the adept's will.
The adept cannot move while using this power, but can otherwise act normally, including attacking, at +2 to all target numbers.

desc: A magical ability to sense immediate personal danger.
effect: The gamemaster makes a secret Perception Test with the adept's Intelligence: Target Number 4 for threats in line of sight, 6 for threats beyond it, 10 for threats in astral space.
Success gives a general feeling of danger, and the adept cannot be Surprised by that threat.
The adept learns only how near the threat is and the relative level of danger, not its nature. Only dangers that threaten personal harm are sensed.
The book warns that this power may unbalance the game; the gamemaster may disallow it or raise its cost.

desc: Focus magical energy into a devastating strike designed to smash through barriers.
effect: Make an Unarmed Combat Test against the Barrier Rating of the target.
Add the successes to the adept's Strength and compare the result to the unmodified Barrier Rating on the Barrier Effect Table (SR2 p.98).

desc: Cloaks the adept's presence in astral space, making them difficult to find with detection spells.
effect: Each level adds 1 die to Resistance Tests against detection spells only.
If the spell cannot be resisted, increase the target number to detect the adept by 1 for every 2 levels.
Does not affect Masking Tests, attempts to read the adept's aura by astral perception, or being spotted in astral space.

desc: The adept's body is exceptionally resistant to extremes of heat and cold.
effect: Each level adds 1 die for resisting the effects of exposure to extreme temperatures.
Helps against burning coals, heatstroke, sunburn, frostbite and below-zero exposure.
Does not protect against physically harming agents such as open flames or the freezing cold of the Antarctic Ocean.

desc: Move over soft or brittle surfaces such as snow, sand or thin paper without leaving any visible trace.
effect: With a successful Stealth Test, the adept can cross nightingale floors without a sound and will not trip ground-based motion or vibration sensors.
Cannot walk across liquid surfaces, though the adept can cross deep snow without sinking.
Can still be tracked by means other than visual cues, such as scent.
